Behold, I repent to Thee, and am among those that surrender.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدۡخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأۡكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأۡكُلُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثۡوࣰ ى لَّهُمۡ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.
translations.pickthall: Lo! Allah will cause those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; while those who disbelieve take their comfort in this life and eat even as the cattle eat, and the Fire is their habitation.
translations.khattab: Surely Allah will admit those who believe and do good into Gardens under which rivers flow. As for the disbelievers, they enjoy themselves and feed like cattle. But the Fire will be their home
translations.arberry: God shall surely admit those who believe and do righteous deeds into gardens underneath which rivers flow. As for the unbelievers, they take their enjoyment and eat as cattle eat; and the Fire shall be their lodging.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِّيَغۡفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكَ وَيَهۡدِيَكَ صِرَٰطࣰ ا مُّسۡتَقِيمࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path
translations.pickthall: That Allah may forgive thee of thy sin that which is past and that which is to come, and may perfect His favour unto thee, and may guide thee on a right path,
translations.khattab: so that Allah may forgive you for your past and future shortcomings, perfect His favour upon you, guide you along the Straight Path
translations.arberry: that God may forgive thee thy former and thy latter sins, and complete His blessing upon thee, and guide thee on a straight path,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعۡمَةࣰۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: [It is] as bounty from Allah and favor. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.
translations.pickthall: (It is) a bounty and a grace from Allah; and Allah is Knower, Wise.
translations.khattab: ˹This is˺ a bounty and a blessing from Allah. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
translations.arberry: by God's favour and blessing; God is All-knowing, All-wise.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ

translations.saheeh: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
translations.pickthall: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!
translations.khattab: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out
translations.arberry: And the earth -- We spread it forth; O excellent Smoothers!

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَعِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
translations.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,
translations.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss
translations.arberry: Surely the godfearing shall be in gardens and bliss,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ

translations.saheeh: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
translations.pickthall: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
translations.khattab: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman
translations.arberry: Therefore remind! by thy Lord's blessing thou art not a soothsayer neither possessed.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: نِّعۡمَةࣰ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ

translations.saheeh: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
translations.pickthall: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.
translations.khattab: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks
translations.arberry: a blessing from Us; even so We recompense him who is thankful.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

translations.saheeh: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
translations.pickthall: In gardens of delight;
translations.khattab: in the Gardens of Bliss
translations.arberry: in the Gardens of Delight

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَرَوۡحࣱ وَرَيۡحَانࣱ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
translations.pickthall: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
translations.khattab: then ˹such a person will have˺ serenity, fragrance, and a Garden of Bliss
translations.arberry: there shall be repose and ease, and a Garden of Delight;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجۡنُونࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
translations.pickthall: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.
translations.khattab: By the grace of your Lord, you ˹O Prophet˺ are not insane
translations.arberry: thou art not, by the blessing of thy Lord, a man possessed.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
translations.pickthall: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.
translations.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord
translations.arberry: Surely for the godfearing shall be Gardens of Bliss with their Lord.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
translations.pickthall: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.
translations.khattab: Had he not been shown grace by his Lord, he would have certainly been cast onto the open ˹shore˺, still blameworthy
translations.arberry: Had there not overtaken him a blessing from his Lord he would have been cast upon the wilderness, being condemned.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
translations.pickthall: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?
translations.khattab: Does every one of them expect to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss
translations.arberry: What, is every man of them eager to be admitted to a Garden of Bliss?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا

translations.saheeh: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
translations.pickthall: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
translations.khattab: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while
translations.arberry: Leave Me to those who cry lies, those prosperous ones, and respite them a little,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمࣰ ا وَمُلۡكࣰ ا كَبِيرًا

translations.saheeh: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
translations.pickthall: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
translations.khattab: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom
translations.arberry: when thou seest them then thou seest bliss and a great kingdom.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَقَدَرۡنَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡقَٰدِرُونَ

translations.saheeh: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
translations.pickthall: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!
translations.khattab: We ˹perfectly˺ ordained ˹its development˺. How excellent are We in doing so
translations.arberry: We determined; excellent determiners are We.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَتَٰعࣰ ا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ

translations.saheeh: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
translations.pickthall: A provision for you and for your cattle.
translations.khattab: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals
translations.arberry: an enjoyment for you and your flocks.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَّتَٰعࣰ ا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ

translations.saheeh: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
translations.pickthall: Provision for you and your cattle.
translations.khattab: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals
translations.arberry: an enjoyment for you and your flocks.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
translations.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
translations.khattab: Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss
translations.arberry: Surely the pious shall be in bliss,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
translations.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,
translations.khattab: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss
translations.arberry: Surely the pious shall be in bliss,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

translations.saheeh: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
translations.pickthall: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.
translations.khattab: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight
translations.arberry: thou knowest in their faces the radiancy of bliss

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وُجُوهࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ نَّاعِمَةࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
translations.pickthall: In that day other faces will be calm,
translations.khattab: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss
translations.arberry: Faces on that day jocund,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ

translations.saheeh: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
translations.pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
translations.khattab: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”
translations.arberry: As for man, whenever his Lord tries him, and honours him, and blesses him, then he says, 'My Lord has honoured me.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةࣲ تُجۡزَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
translations.pickthall: And none hath with him any favour for reward,
translations.khattab: not in return for someone’s favours
translations.arberry: and confers no favour on any man for recompense,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثۡ

translations.saheeh: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
translations.pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
translations.khattab: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord
translations.arberry: and as for thy Lord's blessing, declare it.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
translations.pickthall: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
translations.khattab: Then, on that Day, you will definitely be questioned about ˹your worldly˺ pleasures
translations.arberry: then you shall be questioned that day concerning true bliss.
